description: Searches Milésima's Formula 1 data since 1950 for drivers, teams, circuits, seasons and Grands Prix by name, without accents or capitals, and returns each match with a line of context and its page. Use it when you are not sure of a name. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it).

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Use the language of the person asking.

type.description: Only one kind: driver, team, circuit, season or grand_prix.
